# 29_record_deposit_size.sh - Record the deposit size for the big-ingest decision

<!-- BEGIN pipeline-callers: generated by tools/automation_doc_links.py, do not edit by hand -->
:::{attention} Usually run by a Bitbucket pipeline
`29_record_deposit_size.sh` is normally not run on its own. The Bitbucket pipelines listed below call it as one step of a longer job, after earlier steps have prepared its inputs and environment. Run it by hand mainly for debugging or local testing.

**Called from [bitbucket-pipelines.yml](https://github.com/AEADataEditor/replication-template/blob/master/bitbucket-pipelines.yml):**

- [`1-populate-from-icpsr`](#pipeline-1-populate-from-icpsr), step "Download": [line 111](https://github.com/AEADataEditor/replication-template/blob/master/bitbucket-pipelines.yml#L111)
- [`w-big-populate-from-icpsr`](#pipeline-w-big-populate-from-icpsr), step "Download and commit": [line 531](https://github.com/AEADataEditor/replication-template/blob/master/bitbucket-pipelines.yml#L531)
:::

## Description

Writes the ZIP size and the unzipped size of the deposit to `generated/deposit-size.csv`, using `tools/big_ingest.py record-size`. The "Download" step of both the regular and the big ingest pipeline calls it, so the information is available to the "Check downloads" step and, being part of `generated/`, is committed to the deposit together with the other generated files.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/29_record_deposit_size.sh <project-dir>
```

The ZIP is looked for as `<project-dir>.zip` and `cache/<project-dir>.zip`. See [](#help-big_ingest).
